description: This file implements process information handling, including process memory stats, process enumeration, and platform-specific process name retrieval, within the Thunder::Core namespace.

classes.name: ProcessInfo
classes.description: Represents a process, providing methods to retrieve process details, memory usage, and process enumeration.

classes.name: ProcessInfo::Memory
classes.description: Holds memory statistics for a process, including working set, private, shared, and virtual memory.

classes.name: ProcessCurrent
classes.description: Provides static methods related to the current process, such as user and group management.

classes.name: ProcessTree
classes.description: Represents a process tree, allowing enumeration of child processes and process IDs.

methods.name: ExecutableName
methods.description: Retrieves the executable name for a process handle or PID, platform-specific implementation.

methods.name: ProcessName
methods.description: Retrieves the process path for a given PID, platform-specific.

methods.name: FindChildren
methods.description: Finds child processes of a given process based on acceptance criteria.

methods.name: FindPid
methods.description: Finds PIDs of processes matching a given name.

methods.name: ProcessInfo::Iterator
methods.description: Iterator class for enumerating processes, including all, by parent, or by name.

methods.name: ProcessInfo::MemoryStats
methods.description: Reads and updates memory statistics from /proc/<pid>/smaps.
